text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having become wildly popular, the 
environment surrounding Mejiro Ryan was 
undeniably changing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To answer the support of her fans, she 
stated that she wanted to claim victory in 
both the Takarazuka Kinen and the Arima 
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First up, the Takarazuka Kinen. The next 
clash against Mejiro McQueen was fast 
approaching.
